# S-002 · Kenmerken van bedrijven die AI-technologie gebruiken

## What it says

- Small firms (10-49 staff) are under-represented among AI users: 65% of users against 81% of non-users [W2-003].
- Trade (Handel), the reader's own sector, holds the largest share of AI-using firms, 24% [W2-004].
